Case 01 / App Acquisition Verified Client Impact

On-Demand App User Acquisition Engine

Architected Google Universal App Campaigns (UAC) for an on-demand marketplace app client. Transformed an untracked, high-cost installation funnel into a hyper-local conversion machine.

  • Geofenced Micro-Targeting: Focused ad delivery to a 3km Central Noida radius (Pincodes 201309 & 201307 generated 84% of all installs).
  • Algorithmic Dayparting: Concentrated spend during peak 11:00–13:00 and 17:00 response hours; suppressed unprofitable early morning clicks.
  • Asset Quality Optimization: Deployed 13 tailored creatives; 9 assets achieved Google ML "BEST" grade. Slashed CPI from ₹32.97 down to ₹12.50.

Case 02 / Multi-Channel Meta Dual-Brand Engine

Two-Sided Marketplace Acquisition & WhatsApp CAPI

Solved complex dual-audience marketplace acquisition: Recruiting blue-collar service workers via Hindi direct-response ads while capturing high-value urban customer demand on Instagram.

  • Dual-Brand Segmentation: Provider recruitment separated entirely under Hindi brand with 1-tap WhatsApp and call buttons; customer acquisition under English lifestyle brand.
  • 48-Asset Creative Suite: Designed, tested and delivered 48 production ad sets across 4 aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16 reels, 1.91:1 display).
  • Meta Account Unblocking: Resolved historical Business Portfolio deadlocks and admin permissions without domain recreation or policy penalties.
